title: PhaseNet: A computational framework for identifying phase-separating proteins based on protein language model.
authors: He, Xuxin; Guan, Jiahui; Xie, Peilin; Wang, Feng; Zhao, Zhihao; Liu, Xingchen; Lee, Tzong-Yi; Chiang, Ying-Chih; Yao, Lantian; Wang, Junwen
one_liner_zh: PhaseNet 利用蛋白语言模型(ESM)与CNN-BiGRU等深度学习架构，构建双任务框架识别相分离蛋白并区分自组装与伴侣依赖型，虽聚焦LLPS蛋白识别而非直接建模PPI机制，但方法可迁移至IDR介导互作预测。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates formed via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) play vital roles in diverse cellular processes, and their dysregulation has been linked to numerous diseases. Accurate identification of phase-separating proteins is therefore essential for elucidating the molecular mechanisms underlying these condensates. We present PhaseNet, a dual-task computational framework designed to both distinguish LLPS proteins from non-LLPS proteins and classify LLPS proteins into self-assembling (PS-Self) and partner-dependent (PS-Part) categories. In the first task, PhaseNet integrates features from pretrained protein language models (ESM), sequence encodings (ZSCALE and BLOSUM), and a modular architecture combining CNN-BiGRU and multi-head attention mechanisms. These heterogeneous features are fused using an attention-guided strategy and optimized with HSIC-based regularization to enhance discriminative performance. For the second task, PhaseNet employs Lasso-based feature selection on ESM-derived embeddings, followed by a stacking ensemble of five classifiers: Random Forest, Extra Trees, GBDT, XGBoost, and MLP. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple independent test sets demonstrates that PhaseNet surpasses existing LLPS predictors in both general identification and fine-grained classification. This modular and interpretable framework offers a robust tool for the systematic discovery and annotation of phase-separating proteins.
abstract_zh: 通过液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS）形成的生物分子凝聚体在多种细胞过程中发挥关键作用，其失调与众多疾病相关。因此，准确识别相分离蛋白对于阐明这些凝聚体背后的分子机制至关重要。我们提出了PhaseNet，一个双任务计算框架，旨在既区分LLPS蛋白与非LLPS蛋白，又将LLPS蛋白分类为自组装（PS-Self）和伴侣依赖（PS-Part）类别。在第一项任务中，PhaseNet整合了预训练蛋白质语言模型（ESM）、序列编码（ZSCALE和BLOSUM）的特征，以及结合CNN-BiGRU和多头注意力机制的模块化架构。这些异构特征通过注意力引导策略进行融合，并基于HSIC的正则化进行优化，以增强判别性能。对于第二项任务，PhaseNet采用基于Lasso的特征选择对ESM衍生的嵌入进行处理，随后使用五种分类器的堆叠集成：随机森林（Random Forest）、极端随机树（Extra Trees）、GBDT、XGBoost和MLP。跨多个独立测试集的综合基准测试表明，PhaseNet在一般识别和细粒度分类方面均优于现有LLPS预测器。这一模块化且可解释的框架为系统发现和注释相分离蛋白提供了稳健的工具。
